notes:
Topline: Mid-market B2B SaaS (product analytics & in-app guidance). CTO wants Hosted API to prove latency SLOs (streaming + tool-calls) before committing to Dedicated. Primary decision criteria: 95th pct streaming latency < 500ms, end-to-end agent action latency < 800ms, and <30% uplift in token costs vs current baseline.

Recent convo highlights:
- 2026-02-11 demo + recording (ff_2026-02-11_ConvergeFlow-hosted-poc). Demo used hosted streaming + example tool calling to internal ticketing API. Demo notes: "streaming looked good in dev but tail spikes on longer contexts" (quote from Head of Product, L. Martinez).
- They ran a 7-day hosted POC (sandbox) against a small traffic slice: median stream latency ~180ms, p95 ~620ms under synthetic burst test (50 concurrent agents). Ops flagged p95 as above target.
- Product team cares about prompt/regression gating: they want Redwood Optimize-style eval hooks to block model or prompt rollouts if QA metrics degrade (clarified want A/B + canary gating integrated into CI).
- Technical ask: streaming with chunked tool calls (partial outputs while tool executes), deterministic function calling when tool available, and graceful fallback to smaller model variant if capacity constrained.

Requirements summary (copied from call):
- Workload: multi-turn chat agents + tool-calling (ticket creation, customer history lookup, reranking of KB results).
- SLOs: median token stream <250ms, p95 end-to-end agent action <800ms, sustained throughput 40-60 rps across 3 agent types.
- Cost sensitivity: mid (wants to limit incremental token cost to <30% vs current host).
- Security: mandatory SSO (SAML), audit logs retention 7+ years, KMS for keying, EU data residency for some customers.

POC plan / next milestones:
- Redwood to deliver: 1) POC SLO report with profile-level timing breakdown (tokenization->serve->network), 2) proposal for Dedicated reserved pool pricing for 24/7 capacity + burst, 3) integration pattern doc for canary + A/B prompt gating tied to evals. (owner: SE - Maya Chen)
- ConvergeFlow to provide: representative traffic traces, internal latency budget, security questionnaire responses.
- Tentative canary window: 2 weeks for A/B on 5% of production traffic, then staged rollout if no regressions detected.

Sales notes / signals:
- Strong fit for mid-market Dedicated offering if latency SLOs are met and cost delta is predictable.
- Decision driver: product team wants prediction + observability to avoid regressions; will escalate to procurement once SSQ cleared.
- "If Redwood can show canary gating we can ship next cadence" — L. Martinez (Head of Product).

Open items / follow-ups:
- SE to run targeted p95 investigations with kernel selection and batching tweaks; test quantized model variants to see latency/cost tradeoffs.
- Security: send Prod SSQ and request SOC2 cert copy (SEC-437).
- Finance: provide 12- and 36-month AR options for Dedicated pool (include partial commit + burst) - thread-gm-2367b2_pricing.
